apis.name: petstore
apis.description: A sample API that uses a petstore as an example to demonstrate features in the OpenAPI 3.0 specification. This API allows you to manage pets in a virtual pet store.

functions.name: list_pets
functions.description: Returns a paginated list of pets from the store. You can filter by status and control the page size with the limit parameter.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter pets by their current adoption status. Only pets matching the given status will be returned.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of pets to return in a single response. Defaults to 20 if not specified. Maximum allowed value is 100.

functions.name: create_pet
functions.description: Adds a new pet to the store. The pet will be assigned a unique identifier automatically. The initial status will be set to "available" unless specified otherwise.

functions.name: get_pet_by_id
functions.description: Returns a single pet identified by its unique ID. Returns a 404 error if no pet exists with the given identifier.

parameters.name: petId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pet to retrieve

schemas.name: Pet
schemas.description: Represents a pet in the store. Each pet has a unique identifier, a name, and an adoption status.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier for the pet

fields.name: name
fields.description: The display name of the pet

fields.name: status
fields.description: The current adoption status of the pet

fields.name: tag
fields.description: An optional classification tag for the pet

schemas.name: NewPet
schemas.description: The data required to create a new pet. Only the name is required; the tag is optional.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The display name for the new pet

fields.name: tag
fields.description: An optional classification tag for the pet
